The '''integrated concussion missile launcher''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|weapon]] implant manufactured by [[Vector Technologies]]. [[Haelon Tice]] had one such launcher attached to [[Gender/Legends|his]] right [[Limb/Legends|arm]].<ref name="WHSV" />
